title: UkviAttendanceReportOutboundV1
description: Outbound UKVI attendance monitoring report generated by POST /api/v1/regulatory/ukvi/attendance-reports/generate for a given academic period. Used to fulfil the institution's duty as a licensed Tier 4 / Student Route sponsor to report attendance non-compliance to UKVI. Transmitted via UKVI's Sponsorship Management System (SMS) or electronic reporting channel.

academicPeriodId.description: SRS academic period UUID for which this report was generated.

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this report was generated.

studentCount.description: Total number of sponsored students included in this report.

unauthorisedAbsencesPerEightWeeks.description: Number of unauthorised absences in any 8-week rolling window that triggers a UKVI reporting obligation. Standard threshold: 10.

_attendance_data_completeness.description: Indicates whether attendance data was available from the AM integration. 'pending-attendance-integration' means absence counts may be zero or incomplete; reports in this state should not be transmitted to UKVI without manual review.

students.description: Per-student attendance data for all students with a current CAS assignment.

absenceCount.description: Count of unauthorised absences in the reporting window.

thresholdBreached.description: True if the student has exceeded the reporting threshold and UKVI notification may be required.

attendanceDataCompleteness.description: Attendance data completeness for this student.
